0022600098.text: The Heat (0-1, fifth in the Southeast and one game back) host the Pistons (1-0, first in the Central) in Miami's second game of the 2026-27 season. Miami is 0-1 at home and 14th in the East, while Detroit is 1-0 and second in the East, with Pistons forward Taurean Prince listed as day-to-day for personal reasons and a game-time decision. The Heat won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 121-110 regular-season win in Miami on March 8, 2026, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27.
